title: NEW Dragonwilds Kuldra Skip (1.0.1.2) - Scorned Wilderness Raid - Tech & Tutorial in description
author: Dotxy
description:
Heyo, here's a new way to get through Kuldra's Sanctum quick in the Runescape Dragonwilds 1.0.1.2 hotfix! You can check out the videos below to get the inputs i'm using.

Infinite Double Jumps - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=goKfbT19nkk

Dive Cancel - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LGCddmk_TnM

Feel free to set up a macro for easy infinite flight!


1.Windstep
2. Jump Attack
3. Q (Spell Ring)
4. [any targeted aoe spell]
5. Escape (closes Spell Ring interface)
6. Jump
Repeat steps 2-6 as needed!

This works mostly everywhere, happy flying friends

CHECK OUT THE SPEEDRUNNING SCENE THIS GAME RULES
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g1VvYZdR6ys

https://youtu.be/doVQ9Ph256g?si=_BTxDGPuIu8MBjHM

comments.author: @brendonboyd7668
comments.text:
Just learned this and I’m on PS5
1- Set your spell wheel to where wind step is Triangle R1 input. Set your repair equipment spell to Traingle R2 for Righties or L2 for lefties.
2- Start off by practicing this pattern
Repair Spell, Cancel spell, double jump R1

3- Add wind step to the beginning of the pattern and boom 

I hope this is helpful!
Ps. You don’t need to re input windstep after the first time just keep the pattern from Step 2.
